notes: Access: direct fetch (curl -4/-6, probe.py) timed out on www.dille-kamille.com (TCP connect timeout, no AAAA record) - IPv4 egress issue on this workstation, not a site block. Used r.jina.ai reader proxy for every fetch (canonical dille-kamille.com URLs kept in `link`). Site is Magento (Xsarus agency build); .com storefront serves English (UK) content directly, so no separate translation pass was needed - category names below are the site's own English labels, lightly cleaned. Counts are Magento's layered-navigation toolbar 'N articles found' text on each category page; spot-checked against colour/stock facet sums on Candlesticks (28 = 25 in-stock + 3 not-in-stock, matches). Two nav nodes are genuinely 0-product ('Tableware Terracotta' set, 'Tea glasses') and were dropped, not written as zero rows. No Lighting, Mirrors, or Clocks categories exist anywhere on this site (nav-wide grep confirmed) - Dille & Kamille is a kitchenware/lifestyle chain, not a furniture/lighting retailer, so this is a real absence, not a missed branch. Rule 0.6 overlaps: Mugs/Teacups/Coffee Cups share SKUs (use-case re-cuts of one drinkware pool) - all three kept as separate site nav nodes per Rule 0.6, flagged individually, not summed. EXCLUDED (checked, not oversight): Kitchenware, Food storage, Cooking, Baking, Kitchen textiles, Table textiles (tablecloths/placemats/runners/napkins - Coasters/Trivets pulled out per Rule 0 as non-textile materials), Cutlery (all), International cuisine, Home textiles, Housekeeping, Toys, Home aromas (fragrance sticks/spray/oils/incense), Baskets (storage), Writing & hobbies, Bags, Gardening (tools/seeds), Animals in the garden (birdhouses confirmed = functional nesting boxes, bird food, insect houses), Garden cushions, Toiletries except Soap Dishes (Bathroom Accessories page is a 53-item mixed functional/storage/personal-care roll-up, not cleanly decorative - dropped whole; Toiletry bags, Natural sponges, Bath brushes), Relaxation, Care products, Soaps except Soap Dishes (Soap dispensers page is majority consumable hand-soap refills - dropped; Hand soap, Shampoo bars, Aleppo soap, Rotating soap ball, Mini soaps), Bath Textiles, Food & Drink (all), Gifts (all), Summer (seasonal promo collection, not a genuine category), New, Discounts, Plant rack (metal plant stand = furniture), Coffee pots (majority cafetiere/percolator/filter-jug brewing equipment = cookware), Tea strainers & infusers/Tea caddies/Tea boxes/Tea bag tidy (kitchen tools/storage), Coffee tins/Coffee filters/Percolators, Drinking accessories & Drinking straws (bar tools: ice buckets, ice-cube trays, reusable straws, spout cleaners).
